maya: Heads-up — Sentinel Health dedicated rollout planned Tue 02:00 PT. Plan: slice s4 swap -> s4-v2.4.1 (pinned). KV-cache priming + smoke tests. KMS rotation NOT in this window. Deploybot preflight scheduled 01:30 PT. Need ops + SRE thumbs to lock window. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/relnotes/sentinel-v2.4.1

sam: Can we pin an automatic fallback to v2.3.9 in the deploy config? If the canary shows any >10% regression we should roll back immediately.

jun: What's our p95 latency threshold for this customer? Last week their canary saw ~+8% vs baseline. Need to confirm guardrail.

deploybot: preflight starting 01:30 PT...
```
DEPLOYBOT REPORT - 5187654321
- target: sentinel-dedicated:s4 -> s4-v2.4.1 (checksum ok)
- kvcache priming: started at 01:32 PT, primed 85% prefixes
- smoke tests: 12/12 passing (generate, chat, embed sanity)
- canary latency p95: 85ms (baseline 80ms) => +6.25%
- error rate (5m): 0.03% (baseline 0.02%)
- model integrity: OK
- rollback candidate set: v2.3.9 (pinned)
- artifacts: s4-v2.4.1@sha256:abc123

Automated decision block: Canary within thresholds. No KMS key rotation detected. Deploy queued for 02:00 PT.
```

ops_lead: I can approve if: (1) p95 <= +10% during canary, (2) KMS rotation remains excluded, (3) 15m drain before cutover. Please confirm those are locked into the runbook.

liz: Release notes are updated with the customer-facing bullet and rollback instructions: https://internal.redwood/relnotes/sentinel-v2.4.1 (added note about slight p95 uptick potential). Also added ops runbook link.

oncall: Please add a 15m drain for long-running requests before the slice swap. Also include explicit monitor hooks for 500s, token cost spike, and kvcache-hitrate. I'll be watching metrics.

maya: Ack — updated runbook: drain=15m, p95_threshold=+10%, fallback=v2.3.9 pinned, KMS rotation disabled for window. Canary scheduled 01:30, swap at 02:00 PT. Ops lead, please :thumbsup: to lock.

ops_lead: :thumbsup: locking the window. I'll be on the channel at 01:20 PT to approve the final go.

sam: I'll be on-call for the swap and will run the manual smoke if deploybot flags anything odd.

deploybot: Scheduled: slice swap queued at 02:00 PT. Auto-rollback rule: if canary p95 > +10% OR 5m error rate > 0.5% then rollback to v2.3.9. Alerts will ping #eng-oncall and the release channel.

maya: Thanks everyone — locking calendar and pinging sentinel-eng for customer heads-up now. Will post post-deploy notes in this thread after the window. :rocket:
